summary: Sea Ltd: Shopee (SE Asia + Brazil e-commerce), Monee (digital finance) and Garena (games). Revenue growing ~25-35%, profitable with margins expanding.

rationale.growthHigh: Shopee GMV and ads plus Monee lending growth; ~18% average as growth slows from today's pace.
rationale.targetMargin: MercadoLibre earns ~12-15% operating margin; Sea gets there as Shopee ads take-rate rises.
rationale.exitMultiple: 25x: double-digit grower with e-commerce and fintech, in line with MercadoLibre-type names.

thesis.text: Sea owns Shopee (e-commerce in SEA and Brazil), Monee (digital lending/payments) and Garena (Free Fire). Shopee is now profitable and taking share; Monee is a fast-growing, high-return lender.
bull: Shopee ad and commission take-rates rising
Monee loan book growing quickly with low losses
bear: E-commerce competition from TikTok Shop and Temu
